newsitem.title: LEBANON: Syrian forces seize 500 kg of hashish in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Syrian forces seize 500 kg of hashish in Lebanon.

text.p: Syrian forces seized 500 kg (1,100 pounds) of hashish on Friday in eastern Lebanon's Syrian-policed Bekaa Valley, security sources said.

They said Syrian forces raided a house belonging to Hussein Abdul Sater in the town of Iaat, some 75 km (49 miles) east of Beirut, and confiscated drugs hidden in plastic bags. Abdul Sater was arrested, the sources said.
Lebanese and Syrian forces since 1992 have drastically reduced cannabis and opium poppy cultivation in the Bekaa Valley, a centre of the drugs trade during the 1975-90 civil war.
